mr_discussions.description: List discussion items for a merge request. Use this to list complete discussion threads for a merge request; use `get_merge_request_notes` when only flat notes are needed. It is read-only and returns threaded discussion items, while invalid merge request identifiers, missing resources, and permission failures are reported as errors.

merge_request_iid.description: The IID of a merge request

per_page.description: Number of items per page (max: 100, default: 20)

project_id.description: Project ID or complete URL-encoded path to project
